sloka: त्यक्त्वा पुत्रन् च दारान् च धनानि च गृहाणि च ।ध्रुवम् नः हिंसते राजा सर्वान् प्रतिगतान् इतः ॥४-५३-१६॥
transliteration: tyaktvā putran ca dārān ca dhanāni ca gṛhāṇi ca ।dhruvam naḥ hiṁsate rājā sarvān pratigatān itaḥ ॥4-53-16॥

translations.english: Then the highsoul monkeys reached the hill adjacent to Vindhya mountain on which trees were in full bloom.They sat there, lost in thought.
